metadata.label: Labour input (ESA2010) by industrial classification SNI 2007.   Year 1980-2024
note: 2026-05-29: The reporting of hours worked have changed from million hours to tens of thousands hours. This affects all tables in the Statistical Database that contain hours worked. The change has been made in response to user requests.

2026-06-05: As of 2024, the method for classifying entrepreneurs has been adjusted in the source for the employee’s calculations. This means that the figures are not fully comparable with data for previous quarters and years. This will to a limited extent affect industries with a large share of self-employed,  but also the business sector as a whole. The figures will be revised when the source material is updated.

Correction 2026-08-28: A correction has been made to labour input for the year and quarters of 2024. The revision is needed to correct a time series break 2023/2024 that arose in the May publication of the annual accounts for the reference year 2024. The break was caused by a change in the definition of self-employed used by the statistical product Population by Labour market status (BAS). The error is limited to the business sector and NPISH but has an effect even on the total number of persons employed and the total number of hours worked. The error mainly affects industries with a high share of self-employed. As a result of the correction, labour costs for the business sector were slightly revised for the year and quarters of 2024.

The Church of Sweden is reclassified in the year 2000 from the municipal sector to sector NPISH. Before year 2000 the church of Sweden is included in Municipalities and Federations of local government authorities.

Swedish Standard Industrial Classification (SNI 2007) and corresponds to Kind of economic activity (NACE Rev. 2) up to 4-digit level. In some cases a marginal difference can be found in reported figures due to rounding off calculations between annual and quarterly National Accounts tables.
